description: This Lua script defines event handling functions for a graphical application, including setup, drawing, and input event handlers such as mouse and keyboard events.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initial setup function creating a window.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Render the background and display text information on the window.

methods.name: mousePressed
methods.description: Handles mouse press events, logging the button pressed.

methods.name: mouseReleased
methods.description: Handles mouse release events, logging the button released.

methods.name: keyPressed
methods.description: Handles key press events, logging the key and key code.

methods.name: keyReleased
methods.description: Handles key release events, logging the key and key code.

methods.name: keyHeld
methods.description: Handles key hold events, logging the key.

methods.name: mouseWheel
methods.description: Handles mouse wheel scroll events, logging the delta.
